title: SYJ Production Block V2 Target Schema
description: Phase 9 target block contract. It is a specification artifact and is NOT implemented by the current PoW repository. network_id is the canonical SYJ identity; a Cosmos/CometBFT chain-id is derived externally from the same identity.

network_id.description: Canonical SYJ network identity. The block MUST match the active network identity exactly.

parent_hash.description: Hash of the canonical parent block.

timestamp.description: Consensus-defined block time; exact production time encoding and bounds remain TBD — requires protocol/security/runtime review.

proposer_validator_id.description: Canonical identifier of the authorized proposer validator.

transaction_root.description: Commitment to the ordered transaction set under the active block version.

state_root.description: Authenticated post-state commitment under the active state-root contract.

receipt_event_root.description: Commitment to deterministic receipts/events under the active block version.

consensus_evidence.description: Authenticated consensus evidence sufficient to establish finalization. Exact CometBFT evidence schema is TBD — requires runtime/security review.

commit_certificate.description: Authenticated commit certificate representing the required voting power. Exact encoding is TBD — requires runtime/security review.

application_metadata.description: Non-consensus metadata permitted only where explicitly excluded from consensus-critical hashing/validation. Exact production fields are TBD — requires protocol/runtime review.

$comment: chain_id is not an independent SYJ protocol field. Cosmos/CometBFT chain-id is derived from network_id under ADR-013. Maximum block size, root algorithms, evidence encoding, and production hash construction are TBD — requires protocol, security, and runtime review.
